changelog: The poster, spoken product clip, and jingle now leave as one finished clip.

en.description: Turn a product and an audience into one full-campaign marketing pack: topics taken from public posts, one poster, one product clip, and one jingle. Full-campaign marketing writes the plan, then makes the pictures, clip, and music. Use it when one offer should leave as a set of publishable pieces the same day.
en.summary: Topics from public posts, one poster, one product clip, and one jingle.
en.title: Full-campaign Marketing
